source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Μηνάς, Δαβίδ και Ιωάννης οι Οσιομάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives the three no years at all, so there is no `dates` object. Three names in one line, so three folders, with companionship clauses in the display names because the page gives nothing else to tell them apart. The corpus holds eleven other Davids and none of them is a monk shot with arrows in the company of a Minas and a John; the company is the whole of what identifies this one, and the page says nothing more.
